title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Forward Deployed AI Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Forward Deployed AI Engineer


Who We Are


Enlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs.


The role


This is a forward-deployed engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll talk to the people who'll use what you build, iterate in front of them, and turn rough ideas into things that work.

In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. High autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly.

This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome.


The kind of work


Your projects will change as the business does, but they'll cluster around a few themes:


  • Building and orchestrating AI agents to automate real work across engineering, operations, and marketing.
  • Creating personalized, AI-driven experiences for our customers: systems that understand context and respond in a genuinely helpful way.
  • Turning data and signals into useful systems by taking what we know about a customer and making it drive better experiences and smarter marketing.
  • Building internal tools that give a small team outsized leverage.


You'll rarely get a finished spec. You'll get a goal, some context, and the freedom to figure out the rest.


Our stack


  • AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, voice tooling
  • Primary language: Python
  • Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs
  • Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS
  • Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools
  • Tooling: Git/GitHub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows


You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it.


What we're looking for


Mindset

  • Forward-deployed instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec.
  • Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain technical work to non-engineers clearly.
  • A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software, and the judgment to know when each matters.
  • Self-direction: you thrive with autonomy and ambiguity rather than needing tightly defined tasks.


Core engineering

  • Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend.
  • Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the instinct to build quality gates rather than skip them.
  • Comfortable in shell and TypeScript/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it.
  • Data fundamentals: modeling data well, integrating with third-party APIs, and knowing whether what you built actually moved the numbers.


AI / LLM

  • Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems.
  • Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them.


Judgment

  • Care around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that interacts with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought.
  • Care with personal data: customer information is sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA).

Nice to have


  • Prior forward-deployed, solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for
  • Conversational or voice AI experience (TTS/STT, low-latency streaming)
  • DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance-marketing background
  • Familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern
  • Recommendation or personalization experience
  • A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at

Why this role is different


  • Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast.
  • You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly.
  • AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years.
  • Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business.


How to apply


Record a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

title: AI Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Consultant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Marais Advisory is a boutique consulting firm specializing in AI implementation and competitive intelligence for enterprise clients. The firm operates at the intersection of advanced technology and strategic business transformation, helping organizations navigate and adopt practical AI solutions. Marais Advisory focuses on integrating AI into existing enterprise infrastructure, working closely with private equity firms and their portfolio companies to build AI roadmaps, evaluation frameworks, and multi-agent systems. The team brings deep technical expertise across AWS, GCP, Azure, Python, React/TypeScript, and modern cloud infrastructure to deliver both strategy and working solutions. Recent projects include AI roadmaps, conversational AI platform evaluations, and automated competitive intelligence systems using web scraping and data analysis.


Role Description As an AI Consultant at Marais Advisory, you will work directly with enterprise clients to design, implement, and optimize AI solutions that align with their business strategies. In this full-time remote role, you will translate ambiguous client needs into clear AI roadmaps, evaluation frameworks, and implementation plans. Your day-to-day work will include conducting discovery sessions, analyzing business processes, and identifying AI use cases that leverage existing client infrastructure. You will develop and validate machine learning and NLP prototypes, collaborate with engineering teams to deploy solutions on cloud platforms, and iterate based on client feedback and performance metrics. You will also contribute to competitive intelligence initiatives by designing analytical workflows, structuring data pipelines, and presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Strong consulting and client-facing skills, including requirements gathering, stakeholder management, and strategic recommendation development.
  • Experience at big consulting firm (McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Accenture, IBM, Deloitte, etc)
  • Applied data science and pattern recognition skills, with experience designing experiments, analyzing complex datasets, and deriving actionable insights.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning and natural language processing (NLP), including model selection, evaluation, and deployment in real-world settings.
  • Proficiency with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and familiarity with modern ML tooling, APIs, and MLOps practices.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, non-technical language for executive and business audiences.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience working in or with private equity, enterprise technology, or strategy consulting environments is a plus.
  • Self-directed, comfortable working remotely, and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

title: SDR (Brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDR (Brasil) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote | Part-Time | (BRL) R$1,500–R$2,000/month + Uncapped Performance Bonuses


Important: We are a fast-growing UK-based performance marketing agency working with English-speaking clients, and this role requires fluent spoken English. However, compensation for this position is paid in Brazilian Reais (BRL) and not in USD, GBP, or EUR.


If you're applying because you're expecting international-level compensation due to the English requirement or our UK location, this role is probably not the right fit.


We're looking for ambitious people who want to join a growing company, develop their skills, earn performance-based bonuses, and grow into a larger role over time. High performers are rewarded here, and strong results can lead to significantly higher earnings and career progression.


About the Role

We're looking for a confident, organised, and proactive SDR to help both our clients and our agency grow.

You'll be responsible for handling inbound leads, following up consistently, booking consultations, and prospecting new business opportunities. This is a hands-on sales role for someone who enjoys speaking with people, taking ownership, and being measured by results.


What You'll Do

  • Call inbound leads quickly after they submit an enquiry
  • Book qualified prospects into consultations
  • Follow up consistently with warm and cold leads
  • Handle objections professionally and confidently
  • Prospect new agency clients through cold calling, email, social media outreach, and direct messaging
  • Maintain accurate records in the CRM
  • Keep pipelines organised and up to date
  • Work closely with the marketing team
  • Report daily activity and results

English Requirement (Please Read Carefully)

Fluent spoken English is non-negotiable.

This role involves communicating with English-speaking prospects and clients regularly.


You must be able to:

  • Hold natural conversations entirely in English
  • Build rapport confidently on live calls
  • Understand different English accents
  • Communicate clearly without relying on scripts or translation tools
  • Handle objections and sales conversations naturally

Professional working proficiency or intermediate English is not sufficient for this role.


If you cannot comfortably hold a 15–20 minute sales conversation entirely in English, this role is probably not the right fit.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong spoken English
  • Comfortable making a high volume of calls
  • Experience with cold calling and sales outreach
  • Experience using CRM systems (GoHighLevel preferred)
  • Highly organised and reliable
  • Self-motivated and proactive
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Coachable and willing to improve continuously
  • Results-oriented mindset

This Role Is NOT For You If

  • You need constant supervision or hand-holding
  • You wait to be told what to do
  • You make excuses instead of taking action
  • You're looking for an easy, low-effort position
  • You avoid accountability when results don't go your way
  • You dislike making calls or speaking with prospects

This Role IS For You If

  • You take initiative without being asked
  • You enjoy sales and client communication
  • You take ownership of your results
  • You're ambitious and hungry to grow
  • You thrive in a performance-based environment
  • You want your effort and results to be recognised and rewarded

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with UK or US clients
  • Experience booking consultations
  • Experience selling high-ticket services
  • Familiarity with marketing funnels
  • Familiarity with CRM automations
  • Experience using GoHighLevel

Compensation & Growth

  • Base salary: R$1,500–R$2,000/month (paid in BRL)
  • Uncapped performance bonuses
  • Opportunity to progress into a full-time role
  • Fast-growing company with genuine career progression opportunities

We believe in rewarding performance, initiative, and ownership. The people who consistently create results are the people who grow fastest within our company.


How to Apply

Please submit:

  • A 60-second voice note in English introducing yourself
  • A 2-minute unedited video in English explaining your previous sales experience and why you'd be a good fit for this role
  • Applications that does not include one of the recordings will not be considered.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Please note: All applications must be submitted in English. Resumes must be written in English and the entire interview process will be conducted in English. We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity to grow with the team.


Title : Technical Project Manager / Coordinator

Location : Remote

Employment Type : Independent Contractor I Full-Time

Reports To : Head of Project Management

Works Closely With : Software Dev Team, Product Team, Fellow Ops Project Managers

Monthly Compensation : $2,000 - $2,500


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager who owns delivery end-to-end — from kickoff through launch — across software, product, hardware, and operations work. You’ll sit at the intersection of creative ambition and technical execution, leading the build lifecycle of games, activations, physical technology, and internal tools while protecting timelines, budgets, scope, and quality.


This is a hands-on role for someone who can run multiple concurrent projects, build the systems that keep them on track, and act as the connective tissue across sales, operations, creative, software, fabrication, logistics, finance, vendors, field teams, and clients. You’ll own ClickUp as a central project system, stand up scalable processes and SOPs, and drive profitability through disciplined tracking of scope, change orders, billbacks, and logistics costs. If you like structure, care about quality, and want real ownership — this is your role!!


RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Coordination & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery from kickoff through completion — ensuring projects ship on time, on budget, within scope, and to quality standards
  • Run multiple concurrent projects across operations, keeping all stakeholders aligned
  • Build and maintain project timelines, roadmaps, dashboards, and task lists; flag risks early and drive deliverables to completion
  • Participate in standups, planning sessions, and milestone reviews to keep momentum and accountability high


Systems, Process & ClickUp Ownership

  • Own and optimize ClickUp as the central project management system — workflows, templates, dashboards, task ownership, timelines, dependencies, and accountability
  • Build and implement scalable PM processes, SOPs, checklists, and reporting structures that improve efficiency and reduce confusion, rework, and delays
  • Advocate for and drive adoption of these systems across operations, production, and software teams so they become the single source of truth


Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Manage coordination between sales, operations, creative, software, fabrication, logistics, finance, vendors, field teams, and clients
  • Serve as the communication bridge across technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating requirements clearly in both directions
  • Push for clarity, updates, and decisions to keep projects moving with professionalism and urgency


Commercial Ownership & Margin Protection

  • Maximize client billbacks, change orders, recoverable expenses, and margin by tracking scope changes, additional requests, rush fees, logistics costs, and out-of-scope work
  • Track project budgets, actual costs, timelines, risks, vendor performance, and profitability — escalating issues early and recommending solutions
  • Identify and implement cost-reduction opportunities across logistics, procurement, vendors, installation partners, field services, and operational workflows


Logistics & Deployment

  • Improve logistics planning and execution — shipping, receiving, staging, storage, installation, pickup, returns, site readiness, and deployment tracking
  • Track vendors, purchase orders, deliveries, and project dependencies, ensuring nothing slips between teams


Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead continuous operational improvement — identifying inefficiencies, strengthening internal accountability, improving vendor performance, and creating repeatable systems
  • Own the design-to-development handoff so files and assets are complete and developer-ready before a build begins


QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of project management experience, ideally in a digital agency, software, experiential, or tech-adjacent environment, with a track record owning delivery end-to-end
  • Proven ability to run multiple concurrent projects and drive them to completion independently
  • Deep, hands-on experience with ClickUp (or similar: Asana, Monday, Jira) — not just using it, but designing workflows, dashboards, and templates others rely on
  • Strong commercial instincts: experience tracking budgets, change orders, billbacks, recoverable costs, and protecting margin
  • Experience coordinating logistics, vendors, procurement, and/or field/installation work
  • Solid understanding of QA concepts and what good testing looks like in a fast-paced build cycle
  • Basic to intermediate design-file literacy (Figma, Photoshop, or similar) for reviewing handoff readiness
  • Clear, direct communicator who can translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders and push for accountability
  • Strong timeline and risk-management instincts — you don’t wait to be told something’s off track


NICE TO HAVE - not required!

Background in experiential marketing, activations, branded tech, or DOOH / digital signage

Exposure to hardware/fabrication, installation, or field-services coordination

title: Senior Amazon Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Amazon Account Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping LA SIESTA find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of Senior Amazon Account Manager .


You'll own Amazon growth end-to-end, building systems and shaping AI tools for a global brand.


Compensation:

USD 2.2K - 3.2K/month


Location:

Remote (specific timezone) - GMT-08:00 to GMT-02:00


Mission of LA SIESTA:

\"Improving Lives… One Hammock At a Time\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +3 years experience in Pay-per-click (PPC), Keyword research, Content optimization, Competitive analysis, Amazon search engine optimization (Amazon SEO).
  • You are proficient in Data analysis, Account management.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

The Role:

  • You will own LA SIESTA's Amazon presence end-to-end: catalog, Buy Box, advertising, SEO, and conversion.
  • You will work independently as a remote team member, coordinate directly with our Miami office, and loop in our German HQ on product and brand matters.
  • You are not just running campaigns; you are building a system, and you will have the tools and the mandate to improve how we operate on Amazon over time.


Responsibilities:

Catalog & Listings:

  • Own and maintain the LA SIESTA catalog on Amazon: parent/child structures, variations, attributes, and content.
  • Create and update listings independently, including A+ content and storefront.
  • Design catalog assets and visuals yourself; you produce what you need, no agency dependency.
  • Ensure listing health and resolve suppressed/blocked ASINs proactively.


Buy Box & Pricing:

  • Monitor Buy Box ownership and pricing competitiveness across all active ASINs.
  • Identify Buy Box loss patterns and act fast: pricing, fulfillment, or seller issues.
  • Coordinate with the team on repricing strategy where needed.


Advertising (PPC):

  • Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.
  • Use buying intent signals and search term data to drive campaign structure and bidding decisions.
  • Optimize based on ACOS/ROAS targets: not just spend, but profit contribution.
  • Run systematic keyword harvesting and negative keyword management.


SEO & Conversion:

  • Research and apply high-intent keywords to titles, bullets, backend, and A+ content.
  • Run conversion audits: identify and fix friction in listing content, images, or positioning.
  • Analyze traffic versus conversion gaps to prioritize action.


Analytics & Reporting:

  • Pull and interpret Seller Central reports, Brand Analytics, and Search Term data.
  • Track KPIs (sessions, CVR, ACOS, revenue, BSR) and report clearly to the US team.
  • Connect data dots across catalog, ads, and SEO to find leverage points.


Tool Development & AI Collaboration:

  • Work with our proprietary Claude-based Amazon plugin: use it daily, push its limits.
  • Identify gaps in the plugin's skills and commands, and contribute to improving them.
  • Use Claude, Cowork, and/or Claude Code to automate repetitive tasks and build better workflows.


What You Bring:

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years managing Amazon Seller Central accounts (non-FBA experience required).
  • Hands-on catalog setup experience: not just edits, but builds from scratch.
  • Proven Buy Box management and competitive analysis.
  • Strong PPC skills: campaign architecture, bid strategy, and data-driven optimization.
  • Amazon SEO expertise: keyword research, placement strategy, and content optimization.
  • Conversion optimization mindset: you read listings like a buyer.
  • Fluent in English: written and verbal, professional level.
  • Self-directed: you manage your own time, communicate proactively, and don't wait to be asked.


Strongly Preferred:

  • Technical background: you are comfortable with data, APIs, or automation.
  • Design skills: you can produce your own listing images and catalog visuals (Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent).
  • Experience with Claude AI, Cowork, or Claude Code.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI-assisted workflows.
  • Experience working across international teams (US/Europe).


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote position with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Direct ownership of a meaningful, high-visibility channel.
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tooling: and the opportunity to shape it.
  • Collaboration with a passionate, international team.
  • A brand with real products, real customers, and real growth potential.


Job benefits:

  • PTO.
  • Remote work.


Your potential leader:

  • Carl Maximilian Grisar - CEO of Relaxation at LA SIESTA

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veterinary Radiologist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist

Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and adaptable Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience recruiting across multiple industries and mid-level roles , including global and remote hiring.

This role is critical to building a high-quality, scalable team. You will partner closely with hiring managers across departments to identify talent needs, run efficient hiring processes, and bring in candidates who align with both skill requirements and company culture.


Key Responsibilities


Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for mid-level roles across functions (Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, etc.)
  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and candidate profiles
  • Manage job postings across platforms and optimize for visibility and quality
  • Screen candidates, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate hiring processes
  • Drive structured and efficient interview workflows


Global & Remote Hiring

  • Source and recruit candidates across different regions and time zones
  • Manage remote hiring processes and candidate experience end-to-end
  • Navigate international talent pools and adapt sourcing strategies accordingly
  • Ensure smooth coordination across distributed teams


Sourcing & Pipeline Building

  • Proactively source candidates through , job boards, and other channels
  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for recurring roles
  • Identify and engage passive candidates
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies based on role and market conditions


Process & Operations

  • Track candidate progress and maintain organized pipelines
  • Improve recruiting workflows, documentation, and systems
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Support reporting on hiring metrics and pipeline health


Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–5+ years of experience in recruiting or talent acquisition
  • Experience hiring across multiple industries or functions
  • Proven experience recruiting mid-level roles end-to-end
  • Experience with remote and global hiring
  • Strong sourcing skills (, outbound, etc.)
  • Excellent organizational and pipeline management skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities


What Makes You Exceptional

  • You can quickly understand different roles across functions and industries
  • You are resourceful and know how to find talent in competitive markets
  • You bring structure and clarity to hiring processes
  • You are highly responsive and keep both candidates and hiring managers aligned
  • You balance speed with quality in hiring decisions
  • You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment


Why This Role Matters

As Carepod grows, hiring the right people efficiently becomes a key driver of success.

  • This role ensures we build strong teams across functions and geographies by bringing in high-quality talent and maintaining a structured, scalable hiring process. Your work will directly impact team performance, company culture, and our ability to grow effectively.


Requirements added by the job poster

• 3+ years of Staffing and Recruiting experience

• 3+ years of work experience with 360 Recruitment

title: Consultor Funcional SAP (FI/CO)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor Funcional SAP (FI/CO) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Consultor Funcional SAP (FI/CO)


Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atende um cliente do segmento de agronegócio , em um programa estratégico de transformação digital , com foco na evolução dos processos de backoffice financeiro e controladoria utilizando SAP S/4HANA.

O projeto tem como objetivo garantir a integridade contábil e otimizar processos financeiros, conectando áreas de negócio e tecnologia em um ambiente altamente integrado.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em especificações funcionais (FS) e técnicas (DS)
  • Atuar junto aos Business Partners no entendimento e refinamento de demandas
  • Elaborar fluxos de processos (AS-IS / TO-BE) e diagramas em BPMN
  • Mapear integrações e impactos entre módulos SAP (FI/CO, MM, SD, entre outros)
  • Apoiar times técnicos (ABAP/Integração) na viabilidade das soluções
  • Criar e executar cenários de testes funcionais e integrados (UAT, smoke tests)
  • Acompanhar transportes e validações até ambiente produtivo
  • Garantir documentação funcional clara e alinhada à governança do projeto
  • Apoiar homologações com usuários-chave


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida com SAP S/4HANA nos módulos FI e CO
  • Vivência com processos financeiros end-to-end (P2P e OTC)
  • Experiência na elaboração de especificações funcionais e técnicas
  • Conhecimento em integração entre módulos SAP (FI/MM/SD)
  • Experiência com modelagem de processos (BPMN)
  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de tecnologia ou correlatas


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolver problemas complexos
  • Comunicação clara para interação entre áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Proatividade e senso de dono
  • Colaboração em ambientes multidisciplinares
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Capacidade de priorização e foco em entregas de valor


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Presencial

Local: Curitiba – PR

title: Web Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Web Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Web Developer (Shopify and other platforms)


About Client Company:

Our client company is a fast-growing US-based marketing agency focused on building high-performing digital experiences that drive measurable business growth for clients. We cover graphic designs, web designs, web development, and many other services for clients across a wide range of industries.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Web Development Manager to lead our web team, oversee client web projects, and improve the overall quality and conversion performance of the websites we build.


This is not just a developer role. We are looking for someone who can combine technical expertise, leadership, project management, CRO thinking, and strong client communication skills.


Work Schedule: Flexible 20-30 hours/week to start and transition to full-time very quickly. US Hours.


What You’ll Be Responsible For

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor the web development team
  • Assign projects based on team strengths and workload capacity
  • Review work to ensure high-quality standards across all projects
  • Support team growth, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Help improve internal web development processes and workflows

Web Development & CRO

  • Build and optimize websites using Shopify, WordPress, Framer, and Webflow
  • Conduct Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) audits to improve website performance
  • Identify website issues that negatively impact conversions and user experience
  • Improve site structure, speed, responsiveness, and usability
  • Support troubleshooting and technical problem-solving on complex projects

Project Management

  • Manage multiple web projects simultaneously from kickoff to launch
  • Create timelines, prioritize tasks, and ensure projects are delivered on time
  • Coordinate with designers, marketers, copywriters, and developers
  • Maintain organized project documentation and communication

Client Communication

  • Lead client meetings for website projects
  • Explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical clients
  • Provide project updates and manage client expectations professionally
  • Build strong long-term relationships through excellent customer service

AI & Innovation

  • Use modern AI tools such as Lovable, Google Stitch, and other AI-assisted web development platforms
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency using AI workflows
  • Stay updated on emerging AI tools and web development trends
  • Help implement scalable systems and processes using AI technology


Requirements

Technical Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on web development experience
  • Strong experience with: Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, and Framer.
  • Strong understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience identifying conversion bottlenecks and improving website performance
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Understanding of responsive design and mobile optimization
  • Experience with website speed optimization and SEO best practices
  • Familiarity with tracking setup including pixels, Google Tag Manager, and analytics tools


Leadership & Communication

  • Previous experience leading or mentoring developers
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Comfortable working directly with clients and presenting solutions


Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience working in a marketing agency environment
  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows
  • Familiarity with UX/UI best practices
  • Experience improving operational efficiency within a web team

title: Senior Amazon Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Amazon Account Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping LA SIESTA find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of Senior Amazon Account Manager .


You'll own Amazon growth end-to-end, building systems and shaping AI tools for a global brand.


Compensation:

USD 2.2K - 3.2K/month


Location:

Remote (specific timezone) - GMT-08:00 to GMT-02:00


Mission of LA SIESTA:

\"Improving Lives… One Hammock At a Time\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +3 years experience in Pay-per-click (PPC), Keyword research, Content optimization, Competitive analysis, Amazon search engine optimization (Amazon SEO).
  • You are proficient in Data analysis, Account management.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

The Role:

  • You will own LA SIESTA's Amazon presence end-to-end: catalog, Buy Box, advertising, SEO, and conversion.
  • You will work independently as a remote team member, coordinate directly with our Miami office, and loop in our German HQ on product and brand matters.
  • You are not just running campaigns; you are building a system, and you will have the tools and the mandate to improve how we operate on Amazon over time.


Responsibilities:

Catalog & Listings:

  • Own and maintain the LA SIESTA catalog on Amazon: parent/child structures, variations, attributes, and content.
  • Create and update listings independently, including A+ content and storefront.
  • Design catalog assets and visuals yourself; you produce what you need, no agency dependency.
  • Ensure listing health and resolve suppressed/blocked ASINs proactively.


Buy Box & Pricing:

  • Monitor Buy Box ownership and pricing competitiveness across all active ASINs.
  • Identify Buy Box loss patterns and act fast: pricing, fulfillment, or seller issues.
  • Coordinate with the team on repricing strategy where needed.


Advertising (PPC):

  • Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.
  • Use buying intent signals and search term data to drive campaign structure and bidding decisions.
  • Optimize based on ACOS/ROAS targets: not just spend, but profit contribution.
  • Run systematic keyword harvesting and negative keyword management.


SEO & Conversion:

  • Research and apply high-intent keywords to titles, bullets, backend, and A+ content.
  • Run conversion audits: identify and fix friction in listing content, images, or positioning.
  • Analyze traffic versus conversion gaps to prioritize action.


Analytics & Reporting:

  • Pull and interpret Seller Central reports, Brand Analytics, and Search Term data.
  • Track KPIs (sessions, CVR, ACOS, revenue, BSR) and report clearly to the US team.
  • Connect data dots across catalog, ads, and SEO to find leverage points.


Tool Development & AI Collaboration:

  • Work with our proprietary Claude-based Amazon plugin: use it daily, push its limits.
  • Identify gaps in the plugin's skills and commands, and contribute to improving them.
  • Use Claude, Cowork, and/or Claude Code to automate repetitive tasks and build better workflows.


What You Bring:

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years managing Amazon Seller Central accounts (non-FBA experience required).
  • Hands-on catalog setup experience: not just edits, but builds from scratch.
  • Proven Buy Box management and competitive analysis.
  • Strong PPC skills: campaign architecture, bid strategy, and data-driven optimization.
  • Amazon SEO expertise: keyword research, placement strategy, and content optimization.
  • Conversion optimization mindset: you read listings like a buyer.
  • Fluent in English: written and verbal, professional level.
  • Self-directed: you manage your own time, communicate proactively, and don't wait to be asked.


Strongly Preferred:

  • Technical background: you are comfortable with data, APIs, or automation.
  • Design skills: you can produce your own listing images and catalog visuals (Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent).
  • Experience with Claude AI, Cowork, or Claude Code.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI-assisted workflows.
  • Experience working across international teams (US/Europe).


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote position with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Direct ownership of a meaningful, high-visibility channel.
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tooling: and the opportunity to shape it.
  • Collaboration with a passionate, international team.
  • A brand with real products, real customers, and real growth potential.


Job benefits:

  • PTO.
  • Remote work.


Your potential leader:

  • Carl Maximilian Grisar - CEO of Relaxation at LA SIESTA

title: Scrum Master
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Scrum Master em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A nossa paixão coloca-nos no lugar certo.

A CodeWin nasceu da fusão de duas empresas líderes no setor tecnológico: Decode e Sowin . Unimos a nossa paixão, os nossos talentos, conhecimentos e experiências para levar até às nossas pessoas e parceiros as melhores soluções em transformação digital e consultoria. A nossa expertise assenta em Software Development, ERP, CRM, Data Strategy e Digital Experiences.

Queremos contribuir para um mundo melhor e sabemos que isso só é possível equilibrando a evolução tecnológica com o bem-estar das empresas, pessoas e sociedade. Para isso, precisamos das pessoas certas. Para isso, precisamos de ti!


O que precisas para ter o nosso CODE:


  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência como Scrum Master;
  • Certificação Scrum Master;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipa;
  • Fluente em Inglês;

O que temos para ser o WIN que te falta:

- Acompanhamento personalizado. Preocupamo-nos com o teu bem-estar e desenvolvimento. Queremos proporcionar-te o equilíbrio certo entre a tua vida pessoal e profissional, queremos ver-te evoluir.

- Trabalhamos com um objetivo. Somos flexíveis no horário e oferecemos a possibilidade de trabalho remoto. O importante é cumprires os teus objetivos e sentires-te realizado.

- Investimos na tua carreira. Damos-te acesso a formação certificada, plataformas online e centro de exames Pearson VUE.

- Experiência e destaque no mercado tecnológico. A CodeWin pertence a um grupo multinacional com 24 marcas, mais de 7.000 colaboradores e presença em 14 países.

- Um conjunto de benefícios para o teu dia-a-dia. Seguro de saúde, seguro de vida e acidentes pessoais, um leque de descontos e benefícios, plano de telecomunicações e muito mais.

- Damos importância ao que realmente importa. Disponibilizamos-te consultas gratuitas de medicina geral, nutrição e psicologia.


Queremos marcar pela diferença com as nossas ideias e soluções. Para isso, precisamos de ti e de unir as nossas forças. Aceitas o desafio?

Não discriminamos com base em idade, etnia, orientação sexual, género, deficiência ou qualquer fator que não seja o mérito. Todas as candidaturas com competências para o cargo são bem-vindas!

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations.   • 100% remote work

title: Vulnerability Engineer / Security Tester - +5 years - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vulnerability Engineer / Security Tester - +5 years - Contractor in USD em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer, we are looking for a full-remote Vulnerability Engineer / Security Tester.


Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Execute and support application vulnerability assessments (SAST, DAST, SCA, and manual code review), ensuring findings are accurate, actionable, and relevant to application risk;
  • Validate scanner results, perform false-positive analysis, and track findings through remediation, including retesting to confirm effective fixes;
  • Manage multiple application security initiatives concurrently while meeting strict timelines in a fast paced environment;
  • Prioritize vulnerabilities based on business impact, exploitability, exposure, and likelihood, using industry best practices (e.g., CVSS scoring);
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reports tracking vulnerability metrics such as severity distribution, remediation SLAs, and mean time to remediation (MTTR);
  • Support the integration of security scanning and vulnerability workflows into CI/CD pipelines, leveraging existing tooling and automation;
  • Facilitate remediation planning by providing actionable recommendations and coordinating root cause analysis;
  • Support threat modeling and application risk assessments, with a focus on discovering insecure design patterns;
  • Participate in high‑severity or zero‑day vulnerability response activities, including impact analysis and coordinated remediation efforts, as needed;
  • Provide input into policies and standards related to application and cloud security controls;


Profile:

  • Bachelor or Master degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related discipline—or equivalent professional experience;
  • +5 years of relevant experience in application security and/or vulnerability management;
  • Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., OWASP Top 10) and secure architecture principles;
  • Proficiency in using Burp Suite for manual security testing of web applications and APIs, including validation of automated findings and identification of complex authentication, authorization, and business‑logic vulnerabilities;
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Burp Suite, Fortify, Checkmarx, SonarQube, Black Duck, Tenable, and common network discovery tools (e.g., Nmap);
  • Familiarity with NIST, MITRE ATT&CK, and CIS benchmarks;
  • Programming/scripting proficiency in languages such as Python, Java, .NET, or similar;
  • Excellent documentation, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills;
  • Fluent in English;


Desirable:

  • Professional certifications (e.g., Security+, SSCP, GWAPT, or pursuing CISSP, OSCP).
  • Experience using the ServiceNow platform for vulnerability or incident tracking.
  • Proficiency in Azure cloud and Azure DevOps environments.
  • Experience using Power BI or similar tools to visualize vulnerability metrics and remediation trends for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 6 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese )



Skills:

  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.
  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 6 months

title: Operations Manager (Product)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager (Product) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.


Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.

➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.

➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).

➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.

➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.


Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.

➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.

➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).

➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.

➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.

➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.

➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.


Requisitos Diferenciais:

➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).

➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.

➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.

➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.

➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.

➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.

➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.

➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).

➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços.

➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.

➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).

➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades :

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.

➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

➢ Proatividade

➢ Pensamento analítico

➢ Orientação a resultados

➢ Colaboração

➢ Adaptabilidade

➢ Aprendizado contínuo

title: Tech Lead - Java
description:

Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Quem ocupar essa posição desempenhará um papel crucial na liderança técnica, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da otimização do fluxo de valor (Value Stream) e da implementação de soluções de alta qualidade que estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios dos nossos clientes.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Liderança técnica: Fornece liderança e orientação técnica à equipe de desenvolvimento, estabelecendo padrões de qualidade, aderindo às melhores práticas e garantindo a implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes e escaláveis.
  • Compreensão do fluxo de valor: Trabalha com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender o fluxo de valor completo, desde a concepção da ideia até a entrega do produto, identificando áreas de melhoria e reduzindo desperdícios no processo.
  • Colaboração com equipes multifuncionais: Trabalha em estreita colaboração com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender as necessidades dos negócios, traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos e garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais do projeto e do cliente.
  • Gerenciamento de projetos e entregas: Monitora o progresso dos projetos, identifique gargalos e proponha soluções para garantir que os prazos e os padrões de qualidade sejam cumpridos. Além disso, coordene a implementação de práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega.
  • Planejamento e design técnico: Lidera o planejamento e o design técnico de projetos de integração e API, garantindo a aplicação de melhores práticas, reutilização e escalabilidade. Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Entrega contínua de valor: Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega.
  • Desenvolvimento e revisão de código : Desenvolve acompanha o desenvolvimento de integrações e APIs, fornecendo orientações técnicas e conduzindo revisões de código para garantir a qualidade e a aderência às normas e práticas recomendadas.
  • Mentoria e desenvolvimento da equipe: Promove o crescimento e o desenvolvimento da equipe de desenvolvimento por meio de mentoria, compartilhamento de conhecimento e promoção de um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo. Isso inclui a realização de sessões de treinamento, fornecendo feedback construtivo e apoiando a resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Medição e melhoria de resultados: Utiliza métricas e indicadores relevantes para avaliar o sucesso das soluções entregues, identificar áreas de melhoria e garantir a satisfação das partes interessadas.
  • Comunicação e apresentação de resultados: Comunica-se efetivamente com as partes interessadas em todos os níveis da organização, incluindo a apresentação de resultados, o compartilhamento de atualizações de projetos e a discussão de questões técnicas e de negócios.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Conhecimento sólido em linguagens de programação e frameworks relevantes para o domínio do projeto (por exemplo: Java, .NET, JavaScript, Python, etc.), com experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos e soluções em ambientes empresariais
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e design de APIs, incluindo o uso de padrões como REST, SOAP e gRPC.
  • Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos.
  • Experiência com práticas de integração de sistemas, como ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), SOA (Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços) e iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service).
  • Proficiência em bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL), bem como em tecnologias de armazenamento e recuperação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) e ferramentas associadas, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI e Travis CI.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum e Kanban, e experiência na aplicação de princípios Lean no gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Domínio em automação de testes e ferramentas de garantia de qualidade, como Selenium, JUnit, TestNG e outras.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações e APIs, incluindo autenticação, autorização, criptografia e conformidade com regulamentações e padrões relevantes.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem, como AWS, Azure e Google Cloud Platform.
  • Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento de aplicativos.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.
