title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização.


Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.

➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.

➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).

➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.

➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.


Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.

➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).

➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.

➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).

➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.

➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).

➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).

➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.

➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.

➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).

➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.

➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.

➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme).

➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.

➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.

➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.

➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.

➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.


Requisitos Diferenciais:

➢ Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).

➢ Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.

➢ Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.

➢ Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.

➢ Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.

➢ Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência:

➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.

➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.

➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).

➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).

➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços.

➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Cloud, etc.).

➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).

➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).

➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.

➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).

➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades :

➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.

➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.

➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.

➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

Habilidades Comportamentais Desejáveis:

➢ Proatividade

➢ Pensamento analítico

➢ Orientação a resultados

➢ Colaboração

➢ Adaptabilidade

➢ Aprendizado contínuo

Além disso, coordene a implementação de práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega.

Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Entrega contínua de valor: Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Forward Deployed AI Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Forward Deployed AI Engineer


Who We Are


Enlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs.


The role


This is a forward-deployed engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll talk to the people who'll use what you build, iterate in front of them, and turn rough ideas into things that work.

In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. High autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly.

This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome.


The kind of work


Your projects will change as the business does, but they'll cluster around a few themes:


  • Building and orchestrating AI agents to automate real work across engineering, operations, and marketing.
  • Creating personalized, AI-driven experiences for our customers: systems that understand context and respond in a genuinely helpful way.
  • Turning data and signals into useful systems by taking what we know about a customer and making it drive better experiences and smarter marketing.
  • Building internal tools that give a small team outsized leverage.


You'll rarely get a finished spec. You'll get a goal, some context, and the freedom to figure out the rest.


Our stack


  • AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, voice tooling
  • Primary language: Python
  • Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs
  • Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS
  • Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools
  • Tooling: Git/GitHub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows


You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it.


What we're looking for


Mindset

  • Forward-deployed instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec.
  • Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain technical work to non-engineers clearly.
  • A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software, and the judgment to know when each matters.
  • Self-direction: you thrive with autonomy and ambiguity rather than needing tightly defined tasks.


Core engineering

  • Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend.
  • Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the instinct to build quality gates rather than skip them.
  • Comfortable in shell and TypeScript/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it.
  • Data fundamentals: modeling data well, integrating with third-party APIs, and knowing whether what you built actually moved the numbers.


AI / LLM

  • Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems.
  • Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them.


Judgment

  • Care around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that interacts with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought.
  • Care with personal data: customer information is sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA).

Nice to have


  • Prior forward-deployed, solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for
  • Conversational or voice AI experience (TTS/STT, low-latency streaming)
  • DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance-marketing background
  • Familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern
  • Recommendation or personalization experience
  • A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at

Why this role is different


  • Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast.
  • You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly.
  • AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years.
  • Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business.


How to apply


Record a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

description:

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar na configuração e manutenção de soluções mobile utilizando SYCLO Dynamic Forms e/ou SAP Service Asset Manager (SSAM).
  • Desenvolver e sustentar soluções utilizando ABAP para integração e customização de processos SAP.
  • Desenvolver e consumir serviços OData para integração entre aplicações SAP e plataformas mobile.
  • Atuar na manutenção e gestão de dados mestres de manutenção, incluindo:
  • Equipment.
  • Classification.
  • Estruturas e tabelas relacionadas.
  • Atuar em processos de manutenção preventiva no SAP PM, incluindo:
  • Maintenance Plans.
  • Maintenance Items.
  • Maintenance Task Lists.
  • Estruturas e tabelas relacionadas.
  • Realizar análises técnicas, correções e melhorias em processos de manutenção e mobilidade SAP.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e sustentação de integrações entre aplicações SAP e sistemas corporativos.
  • Executar troubleshooting, identificação de falhas e suporte técnico em ambientes produtivos.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes funcionais e técnicas para implementação de melhorias e novas funcionalidades.
  • Participar de atividades de documentação técnica e disseminação de conhecimento dentro da equipe.
  • Atuar em ambientes multiculturais com comunicação frequente em inglês.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com configuração SYCLO Dynamic Forms e/ou SAP Service Asset Manager (SSAM).
  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Conhecimento em serviços e integrações OData.
  • Experiência com SAP PM (Plant Maintenance).
  • Conhecimento em Maintenance Master Data.
  • Experiência em processos de manutenção preventiva
  • Tabelas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em integrações e arquitetura SAP.
  • Experiência em análise, troubleshooting e suporte de aplicações SAP.
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento, manutenção e sustentação de soluções corporativas.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (OBRIGATÓRIO).

Hr Path Group

We’re looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.


What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu products membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: AI Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Consultant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Marais Advisory is a boutique consulting firm specializing in AI implementation and competitive intelligence for enterprise clients. The firm operates at the intersection of advanced technology and strategic business transformation, helping organizations navigate and adopt practical AI solutions. Marais Advisory focuses on integrating AI into existing enterprise infrastructure, working closely with private equity firms and their portfolio companies to build AI roadmaps, evaluation frameworks, and multi-agent systems. The team brings deep technical expertise across AWS, GCP, Azure, Python, React/TypeScript, and modern cloud infrastructure to deliver both strategy and working solutions. Recent projects include AI roadmaps, conversational AI platform evaluations, and automated competitive intelligence systems using web scraping and data analysis.


Role Description As an AI Consultant at Marais Advisory, you will work directly with enterprise clients to design, implement, and optimize AI solutions that align with their business strategies. In this full-time remote role, you will translate ambiguous client needs into clear AI roadmaps, evaluation frameworks, and implementation plans. Your day-to-day work will include conducting discovery sessions, analyzing business processes, and identifying AI use cases that leverage existing client infrastructure. You will develop and validate machine learning and NLP prototypes, collaborate with engineering teams to deploy solutions on cloud platforms, and iterate based on client feedback and performance metrics. You will also contribute to competitive intelligence initiatives by designing analytical workflows, structuring data pipelines, and presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Strong consulting and client-facing skills, including requirements gathering, stakeholder management, and strategic recommendation development.
  • Experience at big consulting firm (McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Accenture, IBM, Deloitte, etc)
  • Applied data science and pattern recognition skills, with experience designing experiments, analyzing complex datasets, and deriving actionable insights.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning and natural language processing (NLP), including model selection, evaluation, and deployment in real-world settings.
  • Proficiency with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and familiarity with modern ML tooling, APIs, and MLOps practices.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, non-technical language for executive and business audiences.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience working in or with private equity, enterprise technology, or strategy consulting environments is a plus.
  • Self-directed, comfortable working remotely, and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.

title: Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!



Por que fazer parte da SONDA?



Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.



Na SONDA você terá uma experiência de trabalho com diversas oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Um excelente lugar para aprender e contribuir para melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da tecnologia.



Procuramos Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato 100% remoto ou presencial em Brasília (Asa Norte), São Paulo (Osasco) ou Rio de Janeiro (Centro).


Horário: Noturno ou Diurno



Nesta função você irá:

  • Projetar, implementar e sustentar arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras em ambientes Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP), garantindo alta disponibilidade, performance e alinhamento às melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, deploy e integração contínua utilizando práticas DevOps, GitOps, CI/CD, Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure DevOps, GitHub e ArgoCD;
  • Atuar na administração e evolução da infraestrutura cloud, realizando planejamento de capacidade, otimização de recursos e suporte à transformação digital da companhia;
  • Implementar e administrar ambientes conteinerizados utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (IaC), promovendo padronização, escalabilidade e automação dos ambientes;
  • Implementar soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e troubleshooting utilizando CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de incidentes críticos, realizando análises de causa raiz e garantindo estabilidade operacional dos ambientes;
  • Implementar e administrar soluções de segurança cloud, incluindo IAM, WAF, Security Groups, políticas de acesso, compliance e governança;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, realizando análise e otimização de custos dos ambientes cloud;
  • Desenvolver integrações e automações através de APIs e serviços de infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar projetos de dados e analytics utilizando serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e operações, apoiando decisões técnicas e arquiteturais;
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, workflows Git, gestão de repositórios e versionamento semântico;
  • Participar da definição de padrões arquiteturais, melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica dos ambientes corporativos;
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, diagramas e padrões operacionais;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e hands-on em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade tecnológica.



Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior cursando ou completo;
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura, administração e sustentação de ambientes Cloud Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP);
  • Vivência em projetos de infraestrutura cloud escalável, resiliente e segura;
  • Conhecimento avançado em DevOps, GitOps e automação de infraestrutura;
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions e pipelines automatizados;
  • Forte experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform e CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento em containers e orquestração com Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Experiência em automação e integração via APIs para infraestrutura e operações;
  • Conhecimento em Linux, redes, SDN, armazenamento (SDS) e virtualização de containers;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de incidentes em ambientes complexos;
  • Conhecimento em segurança cloud, IAM, WAF, Security Groups e boas práticas de governança;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados e serviços de dados em cloud;
  • Experiência com serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Conhecimento em versionamento Git, workflows de repositórios, tags e versionamento semântico;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de automação e scripting como Python, Shell Script e JavaScript;
  • Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para atuação colaborativa entre times multidisciplinares;
  • Perfil hands-on, proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes ágeis e dinâmicos.



Será considerando um diferencial:

  • Certificações AWS, como:
  • AWS Solutions Architect
  • AWS DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Security Specialist
  • Conhecimento em FinOps e otimização de custos cloud;
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a microsserviços;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta criticidade.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Java Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.


Propósito do Cargo

Como Senior Java Developer , você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.


Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração.
  • Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe.
  • Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput.
  • Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.


Design e Arquitetura

  • Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios.
  • Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos.
  • Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos.
  • Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.


Banco de Dados e Integrações

  • Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados.
  • Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados.
  • Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais.
  • Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.


Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment.
  • Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos.
  • Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe.
  • Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA.
  • Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.


Colaboração e Crescimento

  • Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento.
  • Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java.
  • Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes).
  • Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema.
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras.
  • Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte.
  • Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual.
  • Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta.
  • Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning.
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing.
  • Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs.
  • Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares.
  • Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.


O Que Valorizamos:

  • Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana.
  • Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo.
  • Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness.
  • Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe.
  • Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real.
  • Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício.
  • Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.


Processo de Candidatura:

  • Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn.
  • Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  • Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  • Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.


What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.

description:

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!



Por que fazer parte da SONDA?



Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.

  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (IaC), promovendo padronização, escalabilidade e automação dos ambientes;
  • Implementar soluções de monitoramento, observabilidade e troubleshooting utilizando CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de incidentes críticos, realizando análises de causa raiz e garantindo estabilidade operacional dos ambientes;
  • Implementar e administrar soluções de segurança cloud, incluindo IAM, WAF, Security Groups, políticas de acesso, compliance e governança;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, realizando análise e otimização de custos dos ambientes cloud;
  • Desenvolver integrações e automações através de APIs e serviços de infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar projetos de dados e analytics utilizando serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e operações, apoiando decisões técnicas e arquiteturais;
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, workflows Git, gestão de repositórios e versionamento semântico;
  • Participar da definição de padrões arquiteturais, melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica dos ambientes corporativos;
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, diagramas e padrões operacionais;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e hands-on em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade tecnológica.



Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior cursando ou completo;
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura, administração e sustentação de ambientes Cloud Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP);
  • Vivência em projetos de infraestrutura cloud escalável, resiliente e segura;
  • Conhecimento avançado em DevOps, GitOps e automação de infraestrutura;
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions e pipelines automatizados;
  • Forte experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform e CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento em containers e orquestração com Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Experiência em automação e integração via APIs para infraestrutura e operações;
  • Conhecimento em Linux, redes, SDN, armazenamento (SDS) e virtualização de containers;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de incidentes em ambientes complexos;
  • Conhecimento em segurança cloud, IAM, WAF, Security Groups e boas práticas de governança;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados e serviços de dados em cloud;
  • Experiência com serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Conhecimento em versionamento Git, workflows de repositórios, tags e versionamento semântico;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de automação e scripting como Python, Shell Script e JavaScript;
  • Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para atuação colaborativa entre times multidisciplinares;
  • Perfil hands-on, proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes ágeis e dinâmicos.



Será considerando um diferencial:

  • Certificações AWS, como:
  • AWS Solutions Architect
  • AWS DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Security Specialist
  • Conhecimento em FinOps e otimização de custos cloud;
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a microsserviços;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta criticidade.



O que você pode esperar de nós?


  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?


  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!



+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração



Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.



Faça parte da nossa equipe!

Must-Have:

  • 3+ years managing Amazon Seller Central accounts (non-FBA experience required).
  • Hands-on catalog setup experience: not just edits, but builds from scratch.
  • Proven Buy Box management and competitive analysis.
  • Strong PPC skills: campaign architecture, bid strategy, and data-driven optimization.
  • Amazon SEO expertise: keyword research, placement strategy, and content optimization.
  • Conversion optimization mindset: you read listings like a buyer.
  • Fluent in English: written and verbal, professional level.
  • Self-directed: you manage your own time, communicate proactively, and don't wait to be asked.


Strongly Preferred:

  • Technical background: you are comfortable with data, APIs, or automation.
  • Design skills: you can produce your own listing images and catalog visuals (Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent).
  • Experience with Claude AI, Cowork, or Claude Code.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI-assisted workflows.
  • Experience working across international teams (US/Europe).


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote position with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Direct ownership of a meaningful, high-visibility channel.

  • Collaboration with a passionate, international team.

title: Airline Captain (A320)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Airline Captain (A320) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Captain A320

✈️ Full-Time

An international airline is seeking an experienced A320 Captain to lead flight operations and ensure the safe, secure, and efficient management of commercial aircraft operations. The role offers the opportunity to operate within a rapidly growing global aviation network with strong career progression opportunities.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall command of the aircraft, leading flight and cabin crew, and maintaining the highest safety and operational standards throughout all phases of flight.

Role Overview

The A320 Captain holds ultimate responsibility for the safe operation of the aircraft, crew, passengers, and cargo. The role requires strong technical expertise, leadership capability, and the ability to maintain operational efficiency while adhering to strict safety and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Flight Command & Safety

  • Maintain full command of the aircraft from taxi-out through to final engine shutdown
  • Ensure the safety and security of passengers, crew, cargo, and aircraft at all times
  • Operate the aircraft in compliance with aviation regulations and company procedures

Crew Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate flight and cabin crew throughout the flight
  • Demonstrate strong crew resource management and effective decision-making
  • Maintain high standards of professionalism and operational discipline

Operational Performance

  • Deliver consistent on-time performance and reliable flight operations
  • Manage flight efficiency in line with environmental and fuel policies
  • Ensure all flight operations align with organisational safety and service standards

Requirements

Candidates must meet the following criteria:

  • Minimum 5,500 total flying hours
  • Minimum 2,500 Pilot-in-Command (PIC) hours on multi-crew glass cockpit aircraft
  • Minimum 1,500 PIC hours on the A320 family
  • A320 family aircraft flown within the last 12 months
  • Valid A320 type rating with at least two months validity at the time of joining
  • Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL
  • Current Class 1 medical certificate
  • English language proficiency level 4 or higher

Additional consideration may be given to candidates who are current TRE or TRI instructors .

Note: For flights involving inflight relief, 75% of the total hours may count toward minimum hour requirements.

Compensation & Benefits

This role includes a competitive compensation package designed to support pilots and their families, including:

  • Tax-free salary package with base salary and flying pay
  • Housing allowance
  • Layover and meal allowances
  • Performance-based salary increments
  • Education allowance for dependent children
  • Income protection scheme
  • Life and accident insurance
  • End-of-service benefits
  • Staff travel privileges and airline discounts
  • 42 days of annual leave

Total annual compensation may reach approximately USD $181,000 depending on flying hours and allowances .

Harucon Ventures skaliert E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Markt mit Google Ads auf ein neues Level. Wir sind kein 08/15-Arbeitgeber, wir bauen ein Team, das remote arbeitet, aber trotzdem zusammen ist.

Dieses Jahr? Mallorca. Nächstes Jahr? Portugal. Immer anders. Immer unvergesslich.

Du bist der erste Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden. Über und Social Media baust du echte Gespräche auf, qualifizierst Interessenten und buchst Ersttermine für unser Closing-Team. Kein Cold Calling. Reines Chat-Outreach, mit Skripten und Prozessen, die funktionieren.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

Remote | Part-Time | (BRL) R$1,500–R$2,000/month + Uncapped Performance Bonuses


Important: We are a fast-growing UK-based performance marketing agency working with English-speaking clients, and this role requires fluent spoken English. However, compensation for this position is paid in Brazilian Reais (BRL) and not in USD, GBP, or EUR.


If you're applying because you're expecting international-level compensation due to the English requirement or our UK location, this role is probably not the right fit.


We're looking for ambitious people who want to join a growing company, develop their skills, earn performance-based bonuses, and grow into a larger role over time. High performers are rewarded here, and strong results can lead to significantly higher earnings and career progression.


About the Role

We're looking for a confident, organised, and proactive SDR to help both our clients and our agency grow.

You'll be responsible for handling inbound leads, following up consistently, booking consultations, and prospecting new business opportunities. This is a hands-on sales role for someone who enjoys speaking with people, taking ownership, and being measured by results.


What You'll Do

English Requirement (Please Read Carefully)

Fluent spoken English is non-negotiable.

This role involves communicating with English-speaking prospects and clients regularly.


You must be able to:

  • Hold natural conversations entirely in English
  • Build rapport confidently on live calls
  • Understand different English accents
  • Communicate clearly without relying on scripts or translation tools
  • Handle objections and sales conversations naturally

Professional working proficiency or intermediate English is not sufficient for this role.


If you cannot comfortably hold a 15–20 minute sales conversation entirely in English, this role is probably not the right fit.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong spoken English
  • Comfortable making a high volume of calls
  • Experience with cold calling and sales outreach
  • Experience using CRM systems (GoHighLevel preferred)
  • Highly organised and reliable
  • Self-motivated and proactive
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Coachable and willing to improve continuously
  • Results-oriented mindset

This Role Is NOT For You If

  • You need constant supervision or hand-holding

This Role IS For You If

  • You take initiative without being asked
  • You enjoy sales and client communication
  • You take ownership of your results
  • You're ambitious and hungry to grow
  • You thrive in a performance-based environment
  • You want your effort and results to be recognised and rewarded

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with UK or US clients
  • Experience booking consultations
  • Experience selling high-ticket services
  • Familiarity with marketing funnels
  • Familiarity with CRM automations
  • Experience using GoHighLevel

Compensation & Growth

  • Base salary: R$1,500–R$2,000/month (paid in BRL)
  • Uncapped performance bonuses
  • Opportunity to progress into a full-time role
  • Fast-growing company with genuine career progression opportunities

We believe in rewarding performance, initiative, and ownership. The people who consistently create results are the people who grow fastest within our company.


How to Apply

Please submit:

  • A 60-second voice note in English introducing yourself
  • A 2-minute unedited video in English explaining your previous sales experience and why you'd be a good fit for this role
  • Applications that does not include one of the recordings will not be considered.
