title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Analytics Track)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Meitu Campus Ambassador (Analytics Track) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.


What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu products membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Forward Deployed AI Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Forward Deployed AI Engineer


Who We Are


Enlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs.


The role


This is a forward-deployed engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll talk to the people who'll use what you build, iterate in front of them, and turn rough ideas into things that work.

In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. High autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly.

This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome.


The kind of work


Your projects will change as the business does, but they'll cluster around a few themes:


  • Building and orchestrating AI agents to automate real work across engineering, operations, and marketing.
  • Creating personalized, AI-driven experiences for our customers: systems that understand context and respond in a genuinely helpful way.
  • Turning data and signals into useful systems by taking what we know about a customer and making it drive better experiences and smarter marketing.
  • Building internal tools that give a small team outsized leverage.


You'll rarely get a finished spec. You'll get a goal, some context, and the freedom to figure out the rest.


Our stack


  • AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, voice tooling
  • Primary language: Python
  • Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs
  • Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS
  • Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools
  • Tooling: Git/GitHub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows


You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it.


What we're looking for


Mindset

  • Forward-deployed instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec.
  • Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain technical work to non-engineers clearly.
  • A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software, and the judgment to know when each matters.
  • Self-direction: you thrive with autonomy and ambiguity rather than needing tightly defined tasks.


Core engineering

  • Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend.
  • Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the instinct to build quality gates rather than skip them.
  • Comfortable in shell and TypeScript/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it.
  • Data fundamentals: modeling data well, integrating with third-party APIs, and knowing whether what you built actually moved the numbers.


AI / LLM

  • Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems.
  • Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them.


Judgment

  • Care around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that interacts with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought.
  • Care with personal data: customer information is sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA).

Nice to have


  • Prior forward-deployed, solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for
  • Conversational or voice AI experience (TTS/STT, low-latency streaming)
  • DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance-marketing background
  • Familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern
  • Recommendation or personalization experience
  • A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at

Why this role is different


  • Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast.
  • You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly.
  • AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years.
  • Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business.


How to apply


Record a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

This role sits at the intersection of production reliability and system design . You’ll own integration health in production, onboard new portals, expand data coverage, and write clean, strongly typed backend code. The team values functional principles such as composability, explicit error handling, type safety, and uses Effect extensively, but prior experience with Effect is not required.


This is hands-on engineering in a system where correctness and clarity matter.


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities
  • Production Triage & Reliability
  • Own first-response triage for portal integration failures
  • Debug login automation issues, crawl failures, and ingestion errors
  • Trace failures across logs, workflows, and monitoring systems
  • Implement clean, durable fixes - not just patches
  • Escalate systemic platform issues when appropriate
  • Portal Onboarding
  • Bring new insurance portals into production
  • Reverse-engineer APIs and browser workflows
  • Build ingestion pipelines and validate structured outputs
  • Ensure integrations remain resilient as portals evolve

  • Maintain strong typing and predictable transformations
  • Guard against schema drift and data inconsistencies
  • Collaboration
  • Contribute to runbooks and documentation

Requirements
  • 4+ years of Strongly Typed Backend Experience  
  • Deep experience in strongly typed languages (TypeScript , Scala, Kotlin , Go, etc.)
  • Careful API modeling and schema validation
  • Comfort designing systems where types act as contracts
  • Functional or Declarative Programming Experience  
  • You don’t need to come from a pure Functional Programming background, but you should be comfortable with immutability, explicit handling, declarative composition, and writing predictable, testable code.
  • AI Integration Experience: Accelerate developers and internal operations by exposing or configuring API and MCP access to our infrastructure, while keeping costs and security under control.
  • CI/CD Operations Experience: Ability to improve GitHub Actions workflows, implement faster CI runners, enhance caching strategies, and manage multi-environment deployments (dev/prod) using Pulumi
  • Infrastructure Management with AWS: Maintain AWS infrastructure including ECS, Aurora RDS (Gel), VPC networking, and monitoring stack (OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, Sentry → but soon Datadog), and AWS access provisioning
  • TypeScript (Backend)
  • Enhance our TypeScript monorepo performance, optimize the Nx build system, migrate from CommonJS to ESM, and improve our Docker-based DevContainers


Nice To Have
  • Experience with Effect
  • Experience with Effect is a strong plus
  • If not, you should be comfortable learning it and working within a composable, typed effect system
  • Playwright or browser automation
  • API reverse-engineering via browser devtools
  • Workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar)
  • Data ingestion or transformation pipelines
  • Observability tooling (Datadog or similar)

  • Experience in the Healthcare industry in the USA

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Forward Deployed AI Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Forward Deployed AI Engineer


Who We Are


Enlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs.


The role


This is a forward-deployed engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll talk to the people who'll use what you build, iterate in front of them, and turn rough ideas into things that work.

In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. High autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly.

This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome.


The kind of work


Your projects will change as the business does, but they'll cluster around a few themes:


  • Building and orchestrating AI agents to automate real work across engineering, operations, and marketing.
  • Creating personalized, AI-driven experiences for our customers: systems that understand context and respond in a genuinely helpful way.
  • Turning data and signals into useful systems by taking what we know about a customer and making it drive better experiences and smarter marketing.
  • Building internal tools that give a small team outsized leverage.


You'll rarely get a finished spec. You'll get a goal, some context, and the freedom to figure out the rest.


Our stack


  • AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, voice tooling
  • Primary language: Python
  • Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs
  • Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS
  • Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools
  • Tooling: Git/GitHub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows


You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it.


What we're looking for


Mindset

  • Forward-deployed instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec.
  • Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain technical work to non-engineers clearly.
  • A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software, and the judgment to know when each matters.
  • Self-direction: you thrive with autonomy and ambiguity rather than needing tightly defined tasks.


Core engineering

  • Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend.
  • Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the instinct to build quality gates rather than skip them.
  • Comfortable in shell and TypeScript/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it.
  • Data fundamentals: modeling data well, integrating with third-party APIs, and knowing whether what you built actually moved the numbers.


AI / LLM

  • Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems.
  • Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them.


Judgment

  • Care around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that interacts with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought.
  • Care with personal data: customer information is sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA).

Nice to have


  • Prior forward-deployed, solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for
  • Conversational or voice AI experience (TTS/STT, low-latency streaming)
  • DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance-marketing background
  • Familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern
  • Recommendation or personalization experience
  • A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at

Why this role is different


  • Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast.
  • You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly.
  • AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years.
  • Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business.


How to apply


Record a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.

  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.

  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).

description:

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk Management Officer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

  • Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.

  • Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes.   • Inglês avançado (com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo);

Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Context

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage.
  • Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications.
  • Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability.
  • Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange.
  • Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience.
  • Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance.


Whom Are We looking For

We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You’ll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value.


Key Qualifications

  • Node.js, TypeScript & React Expertise: Extensive experience with NodeJS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies.
  • TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code.
  • Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand.
  • Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health.
  • Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release.
  • Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus.
  • Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team.
  • Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity.


Bonus Qualifications

  • Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads.
  • AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions.
  • Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus.
  • Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage.
  • Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications.
  • Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability.
  • Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange.
  • Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience.
  • Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance.


Whom Are We looking For

We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You’ll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value.


Key Qualifications

  • Node.js, TypeScript & React Expertise: Extensive experience with NodeJS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies.
  • TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code.
  • Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand.
  • Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health.
  • Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release.
  • Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus.
  • Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team.
  • Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity.


Bonus Qualifications

  • Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads.
  • AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions.
  • Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus.
  • Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.
